summary: Two 33-year-olds (married couple) caught in a heavy thunderstorm descending Blanca Peak, soaked and freezing ~1.5 mi below Lake Como on Como Road with hyperthermia a serious threat; AVSAR met them after midnight and drove them to their vehicle at the lower parking area; both walking, no medical issues.
responding_agency: Alamosa Volunteer SAR / Alamosa County SO
notes: Date = mission date; subjects rescued via meet-and-ride, 0006–0144 Aug 9 operation.
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: peak (Blanca Peak)
